verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A SaaS platform, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis, but the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The Slack and Teams alerts do not qualify as webhooks. The "anything with an API" claim concerns inbound data connectors, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
